Scenario0.Text: Today is move-in day, but you forgot to buy furniture for your dorm room.
Scenario0.Choice1: Buy cheap furniture since it's only for college.
Scenario0.Choice3: Buy high quality new furniture you plan to keep after college.
Scenario0.Choice4: Ask friends and family for unwanted furniture.

Scenario1.Text: You moved in and finished unpacking all your stuff. What will you do with the boxes?
Scenario1.Choice1: Throw all the packaging into the garbage. It takes too long to sort and most of it doesn't get recycled anyways.
Scenario1.Choice2: Break down cardboard and recyclable materials.
Scenario1.Choice3: Save boxes and packaging materials for future moving in/out.
Scenario1.Choice4: Leave materials in the hallway for someone else who knows better how to handle them.

Scenario2.Text: After unpacking everything, you realized that you forgot a couple items.
Scenario2.Choice1: Make a separate car trip to the store to purchase forgotten items.
Scenario2.Choice2: Ask a friend to borrow items, and purchase anything else on the next errand run.
Scenario2.Choice3: Coordinate a shopping trip with roommates or a group of friends.
Scenario2.Choice4: Order everything online with express shipping.
